segments.text: Netaji urged all Indians to unite in the armed struggle to overthrow the British Raj and liberate their motherland.
The INA liberated the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, which Netaji renamed Shaheed (Martyr) and Swaraj (Self-rule) Islands.
The INA advanced alongside Japanese forces towards the eastern frontier of India in Manipur, fighting fiercely at the Battle of Kohima and Imphal.
